newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Moody's says may upgrade Girocredit L-T rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may upgrade Girocredit L-T rating.

text.p: Moody's Investor Service said on Friday it had placed Girocredit's A2 long-term deposit rating on review for a possible upgrade following the bank's recent announcement of plans for a merger with savings bank Die Erste.
In a statement, the agency said it had confirmed the bank's short-term deposit rating at P-1 and its financial strength rating at D+.

Die Erste's supervisory board last week voted to integrate Girocredit into the group as soon as possible, but definitely before September 30, after it acquired a majority stake in Girocredit for 8.24 billion schillings in March.
Die Erste now controls 82 percent of Girocredit's voting shares.
Following the deal, Moody's placed Die Erste's (First Austrian) long-term rating and its bank financial strength rating on review for a possible downgrade.
"The rating reviews of First Austrian Bank and Girocredit will assess the credit implications of this latest full merger proposal," Moody's said.
A link-up of the two would create Austria's second-largest banking group with combined assets of about 670 billion schillings.
